description: Daily US fuel prices from the AAA Fuel Gauge (gasprices.aaa.com). National, state, and metro/county granularity.

fuelTypes.description: Which fuel grades to include in each record. Empty = all four (regular, midGrade, premium, diesel).
fuelTypes.title: Fuel types

includeChangeMetrics.description: When true and history is fetched, also emit `changeFromYesterday`, `changeFromWeekAgo`, `changeFromMonthAgo`, `changeFromYearAgo` (in cents).
includeChangeMetrics.title: Include derived change metrics

includeHistory.description: When true (state/metro modes), include yesterday/week-ago/month-ago/year-ago averages. Default true.
includeHistory.title: Include price history

maxPrice.description: Drop records whose primary fuel (regular by default) is above this price.
maxPrice.title: Max price (USD/gal)

metroNameFilter.description: Only emit metro records whose name contains one of these substrings (case-insensitive). e.g. ['New York','Los Angeles'].
metroNameFilter.title: Metro name filter (mode=metro only)

minPrice.description: Drop records whose primary fuel (regular by default) is below this price.
minPrice.title: Min price (USD/gal)

mode.description: What to scrape. `national` = single record (US average). `state` = 51 records (50 states + DC) with current/yesterday/week/month/year-ago prices. `metro` = metro/county-level prices for the requested states.
mode.title: Mode

primaryFuelType.description: Which fuel grade is used by `minPrice` / `maxPrice` / `sortBy` filters. Default: regular.
primaryFuelType.title: Primary fuel type for filters/sort

sortBy.description: How to order emitted records. Cheapest-first / most-expensive-first / alphabetical by state.
sortBy.title: Sort by

states.description: Two-letter state codes (e.g. `NY`, `CA`, `TX`). Empty = all 50 states + DC. For `mode=metro`, this controls which state pages get scraped.
states.title: States allowlist

title: Fuel Prices Scraper Input
